sample.question:
Logic Circuit is a digital-circuit reading puzzle. The diagram shows input switches on the left (each labeled with a letter and set to 1 = ON or 0 = OFF), logic gates in the middle, and one lamp on the right. Wires carry the values left to right; a black dot marks a wire that branches to several gates. Gate shapes follow the usual convention and each gate is also labeled with its type: AND outputs 1 only if all inputs are 1; OR outputs 1 if at least one input is 1; XOR outputs 1 if an odd number of inputs are 1; NAND outputs the opposite of AND (0 only if all inputs are 1); NOT outputs the opposite of its single input. The lamp lights up exactly when the final wire carries 1.

The switches are set as shown in the image. Evaluate the circuit: is the lamp ON or OFF? Answer with ON or OFF.
sample.analysis:
Read the switch states from the image: A = 1, B = 1, C = 0.
Evaluate the gates in order:
Gate G1 (XOR): inputs A = 1, B = 1 -> XOR(1, 1) = 0.
Gate G2 (OR): inputs B = 1, C = 0 -> OR(1, 0) = 1.
Gate G3 (AND): inputs G1 = 0, G2 = 1 -> AND(0, 1) = 0.
The lamp wire carries 0, so the lamp is OFF.
So the answer is OFF.

gate_semantics.OR: 1 iff at least one input is 1
gate_semantics.XOR: 1 iff an odd number of inputs are 1
